shape.description: Same body, legs and four arches as B-01, but the top is NOT a through cup. It is a pocket with a closed back wall (W in this record) and raised rim, and a curved floor sweeping up to that wall. Only one face is open, with one tab under it. Top view is a rounded square with one tab; B-01 shows two tabs. T-Rex tan and Launchpad orange are the same shape.

physics.behaviour: Not a turn and not the same as B-01. It has one mouth. Under a hole block it catches the falling marble and sends it out the mouth. Rolled in through the mouth, it climbs the back wall and rolls back out.

assumptions: Axes: +x = E, +y = S, z up; z is in slots above this block's own feet. Marble seat in a cup is z=0.68.

Joint rule: a block body is about a cube; pitch is 1 slot; rails stand 0.17 slot higher and nest inside the block above. Each face has a low arch, as tall as the cup is deep (0.33 slot). So the arch of an upper block plus the cup end of the lower block make a round hole at the joint, about 0.65 slot across. The cup-end port and the side round hole are the SAME port: it is a notch when the stack ends there and a hole when a block sits on top. Height is the same either way, n-0.32 slots for the nth block.
Mouth direction is set by rotating the block; plans must place it toward the exit track. Maps do not always show it.
Behaviour when rolled into is inferred from shape.
